summary: Gildan Activewear Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a Third Supplemental Indenture, dated August 13, 2026, which adds three new guarantors — HBI Branded Apparel Enterprises, LLC, Hanes Jiboa Holdings LLC, and Hanesbrands El Salvador, Ltda. de C.V. — to its existing $600 million 4.700% Notes due 2030 and $600 million 5.400% Notes due 2035 indenture (originally dated October 7, 2025). The new guarantors provide senior unconditional guarantees of the notes. This is a routine contractual/supplemental indenture filing, not a special situation. No change in ownership, pricing, or terms of the notes occurs; it only expands the guarantor group.
